specification.equation: Y_mt = alpha_m + f(A_mt, X_mt, year_t) + u_mt
specification.f_decomposition: f(A, X, t) = b_t + g(A, X, t)
specification.commune_effect: unpenalized additive intercept; no commune input in g
specification.year_main_effect: unpenalized b_t inside f; first observed year normalized to zero
specification.time_kernel: year indicators inside the outcome network, with unrestricted network interactions
specification.interactions: immigration, demographics and categorical year enter jointly through smooth tanh hidden layers
specification.feature_absorption: commune and year main effects projected from integrated network predictions and outcomes; raw A never demeaned
specification.causal_interpretation: requires valid panel IV moments and identification of the nonlinear response; not established by fitting
specification.first_stage: unchanged conditional Gaussian KDE, including the previously selected fold-specific bandwidths
specification.structural_class: compact tanh neural network in immigration, demographics and year indicators
specification.complexity_selection: network architecture and number of Adam steps chosen by commune-grouped held-out integrated loss

time_heterogeneity.reference: same empirical common-support profiles as the no-penalty kernel run
